title: Project Manager (Civil)
description:
**Project Manager (JD)**

**Job Responsibilities:**

1. Planning, coordinating and managing all phases of construction projects, including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and closeout.

2. Establishing project objectives, scope and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders and ensuring alignment with client requirements.

3. Developing and managing project schedules, budgets and resource allocations to ensure cost efficiency and timely delivery.

4. Liaising with architects, engineers, contractors and subcontractors to monitor construction progress, resolve issues and ensure compliance with specifications and quality standards.

5. Managing procurement processes, including bid evaluations, contract negotiations and vendor selection.

6. Oversee project budgeting and cost control and manage change orders to ensure adherence to budgetary constraints.

7. Conducting regular site inspections to assess project progress, identify risks, and ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

8. Maintain effective communication with project team members and stakeholders to provide project updates, address concerns and foster strong working relationships.

9. Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocations and procurement strategies.

10. Coordinate and oversee construction activities, ensuring adherence to project schedules and specifications.

11. Evaluate and select contractors and subcontractors based on qualifications, experience and cost-effectiveness.

12. Monitor project progress, track key performance indicators (KPIs) and report on project status to stakeholders.

13. Ensure compliance with safety regulations and legal requirements, prioritising a safe working environment for all involved.

14. Manage construction project documentation, including contracts, permits, drawings and change orders.

15. Conduct regular meetings to facilitate communication, address challenges and to meet project objectives.

16. Provide regular updates and reports on project status, including milestones, budget updates, and any significant developments or risks.

17. Implement and enforce safety protocols and ensure compliance with local building codes and regulations.

18. Carry out thorough project evaluations and assessments to identify areas for improvement and implement necessary corrective measures.

19. Provide leadership and guidance to the project team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.

**Qualifications/Skills:**

1. A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, or a related field.

2. 12-15 years of relevant experience in construction project management, with a track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget.

3. Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes and safety regulations in the Indian context.

4. Excellent project management skills, including effective planning, organising and prioritising tasks.

5. Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical documents, including project blueprints and construction schematics.

6. Strong leadership and communication skills to manage project teams and stakeholders.

7. Proficiency in construction management software, project scheduling tools.

8. Experience in managing large-scale construction projects in India.

9. Experience with construction contract negotiations and claims management.

10. Familiarity with lean construction principles and methodologies.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kolkata, West Bengal

title: PROJECT MANAGER – SITE OPERATIONS, MATERIALS & VENDOR MANAGEMENT
description:
PROJECT MANAGER – SITE OPERATIONS, MATERIALS & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

**Location:** Kolkata  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Function:** Project Management / Construction / Site Operations  
**Level:** Project Manager

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager – Site Operations, Materials & Vendor Management** to take end-to-end ownership of site operations, construction activities, material management, procurement coordination, vendor management and quality control.

This is a **hands-on project ownership role** for a professional who can independently manage site operations, coordinate multiple stakeholders, ensure material availability, drive vendor performance and maintain construction quality and timelines.

The role requires strong **civil construction knowledge combined with material and purchase management capabilities**. The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of site requirements, coordinating material deliveries, managing vendors and contractors, resolving execution challenges and ensuring the site remains operational and project-ready.

The position requires **strong site presence and operational flexibility**, including coordination and supervision of critical material deliveries outside standard working hours whenever required by project schedules.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Project & Site Operations

* Take overall ownership of day-to-day site operations and project execution.
* Plan, coordinate and monitor construction activities to ensure timely completion.
* Ensure site activities are executed as per approved drawings, specifications, schedules and quality standards.
* Coordinate manpower, materials, equipment, contractors and other site resources.
* Monitor project progress and identify delays, bottlenecks and execution risks.
* Resolve site-level technical and operational issues proactively.
* Ensure the site remains ready for ongoing construction and upcoming project activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders for smooth project execution.
* Maintain regular site reports, progress updates and project documentation.

2. Material Management

* Take ownership of **end-to-end material management at site**.
* Plan material requirements based on project schedules and upcoming activities.
* Coordinate timely procurement and delivery of construction and project materials.
* Track material requirements, availability, delivery schedules and consumption.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure materials reach the site as planned.
* Inspect incoming materials for quantity, specifications and basic quality compliance.
* Ensure proper material receiving, handling, storage and movement within the site.
* Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage, shortages and unnecessary inventory.
* Coordinate urgent material requirements and ensure timely availability at site.
* Maintain appropriate material records and documentation.

3. Purchase & Procurement Coordination

* Manage and coordinate purchase requirements for project/site operations.
* Identify material and service requirements in coordination with the project team.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for quotations, availability, rates and delivery schedules.
* Evaluate quotations and support commercial comparison and vendor selection.
* Negotiate with vendors/suppliers to achieve competitive pricing and timely delivery.
* Coordinate purchase orders and ensure materials are procured as per project requirements.
* Follow up with vendors on order status, dispatch and delivery.
* Resolve purchase and delivery-related issues proactively.
* Ensure procurement activities are aligned with project timelines and budgets.

4. Vendor & Contractor Management

* Manage the complete vendor and contractor ecosystem for site operations.
* Identify and coordinate with reliable suppliers, contractors and service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance, quality, timelines and service delivery.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding manpower, materials, execution and schedules.
* Negotiate rates and commercial terms wherever required.
* Resolve vendor-related issues and escalations.
* Ensure vendors and contractors comply with project requirements and quality standards.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with vendors and service providers.

5. Civil Construction & Technical Supervision

* Provide technical supervision for civil construction and related site activities.
* Review and understand construction drawings, BOQs, specifications and execution requirements.
* Monitor civil works including structural, masonry, flooring, finishing and other construction activities as applicable.
* Verify measurements, quantities and execution against approved requirements.
* Identify technical issues at site and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants and other technical stakeholders.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings and specifications.
* Provide practical technical guidance to site teams wherever required.

6. Quality Control

* Ensure quality standards are maintained across all site and construction activities.
* Inspect workmanship and incoming materials against approved specifications.
* Identify quality deviations and ensure corrective action.
* Coordinate with contractors/vendors to resolve quality issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of inspections, observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain consistent quality standards throughout project execution.
* Support final inspections, snag closure and project handover activities.

7. Project Planning & Cost Control

* Prepare and monitor site execution plans and activity schedules.
* Coordinate material, manpower and vendor requirements with project timelines.
* Monitor project costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Track project requirements, variations and additional material/service needs.
* Ensure efficient utilization of manpower, materials and other resources.
* Escalate significant cost, schedule or resource risks to management.

8. Stakeholder & Communication Management

* Act as a key point of contact for site-related coordination.
* Coordinate effectively with management, vendors, contractors, consultants and internal teams.
* Handle site-related discussions and resolve operational issues professionally.
* Maintain clear and timely communication regarding project progress, requirements and challenges.
* Coordinate future site requirements, bookings, deliveries and related operational activities.
* Ensure all stakeholders receive accurate information and timely updates.

9. Site Readiness & Material Delivery Coordination

* Ensure the site is prepared to receive and store incoming materials.
* Coordinate material delivery schedules with vendors and project teams.
* Supervise critical deliveries whenever required based on project schedules.
* Be available for **late-evening/night or midnight material deliveries when operationally required**.
* Verify delivered materials and coordinate their movement to the appropriate site/storage location.
* Ensure urgent material requirements are handled without disrupting project execution.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

* **8+ years of relevant experience** in construction, project execution, site operations, civil engineering, infrastructure, real estate, commercial construction, interior fit-out or related sectors.
* Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in **Civil Engineering** or a relevant technical discipline.
* Strong hands-on experience in **civil construction and site execution**.
* Proven experience in **material management and procurement/purchase coordination**.
* Strong experience in **vendor and contractor management**.
* Experience in construction material sourcing, supplier coordination and delivery management.
* Strong understanding of construction quality standards and site inspection.
* Experience managing multiple site activities, resources and stakeholders.
* Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills.
* Good knowledge of construction drawings, BOQs, measurements and specifications.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to independently handle site-level decisions and operational challenges.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in any of the following areas will be an advantage:

* Interior fit-out projects
* Commercial projects
* Retail projects
* Residential construction
* Infrastructure projects
* Landscaping and external development
* Facility/site development
* Large-scale vendor and contractor coordination

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Project Management
* Site Operations
* Civil Construction
* Material Management
* Material Procurement
* Purchase Coordination
* Vendor Management
* Contractor Management
* Supplier Negotiation
* Quality Control
* Cost Control
* Project Planning
* Site Execution
* BOQ & Quantity Management
* Material Delivery Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Site Documentation
* Problem Solving

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

* Strong ownership and accountability
* Excellent communication and coordination skills
* Practical and hands-on approach
* Strong negotiation capability
* Ability to manage vendors and contractors firmly and professionally
* Good decision-making and problem-solving ability
* Ability to work under project deadlines
* High level of site discipline and operational responsibility
* Flexible and comfortable with site-based working requirements

IMPORTANT ROLE REQUIREMENT

This is a **site-driven Project Manager role** and requires strong physical presence at the project site.

The successful candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of **material deliveries, site operations, vendor coordination and project requirements outside standard working hours when operationally necessary**, including late-night or midnight material arrivals.

Candidates whose experience is limited to **desk-based project coordination, procurement support or purely administrative project management** will not be suitable for this position.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

* Keep the project/site operational and execution-ready.
* Ensure materials are available when required.
* Maintain strong vendor and contractor performance.
* Control material wastage and procurement costs.
* Maintain construction quality.
* Resolve site issues quickly.
* Maintain project schedules and execution timelines.
* Build effective relationships with vendors, contractors and stakeholders.
* Take complete ownership of site-level project execution.

Pay: From ₹700,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:

Job description:

**Job Opening: Project \& Operations Coordinator**

**Location: Sovabazar, Kolkata (Full\-Time, In\-Person)**  
Organization: **Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND)**

**About IND**

The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a pioneering center focused on empowering families of neurodivergent children—especially those with Autism, ADHD, and developmental delays—through structured, parent\-led, play\-based intervention models. Our work is highly process\-driven, results\-oriented, and grounded in clarity, compassion, and accountability. We are expanding our backend team to ensure operational excellence at scale.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Project \& Operations Coordinator who will function as a process executor and systems enabler within IND. This individual will take high\-level ideas or programmes and systematically break them into checklists, timelines, responsibilities, and delivery processes. They will follow up on implementation with various team members, ensure outputs match defined process standards, and audit documentation for accuracy and completeness.

Key Responsibilities (KRA)

1\. Project Breakdown \& Documentation

* **Convert broad programme structures into step\-by\-step workflows**
* **Create internal documentation: SOPs, timelines, checklists, templates**
* **Maintain clear version control and accessibility of documents**

2\. Team Coordination \& Follow\-Through

* **Communicate with various stakeholders (content team, therapists, tech, marketing, etc.) to ensure task clarity**
* **Follow up on individual responsibilities, flag delays or confusion early**
* **Ensure tasks are completed within timelines and as per specifications**

3\. Process Auditing \& Quality Control

* **Audit task completion against assigned checklists and process flows**
* **Identify deviations from standards and report or initiate correction**
* **Help streamline repetitive tasks through templatisation and automation**

4\. Delivery Monitoring

* **Track progress on active projects using simple project management tools**
* **Provide regular updates to leadership and flag critical risks**
* **Close projects with documentation of learnings, process notes, and outcomes**

Who This Role Is Ideal For

* **1–3 years of experience in operations, project coordination, or backend execution**
* **Strong documentation, checklisting, and process\-thinking abilities**
* **Proficient in Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, or project tools like Trello/Asana**
* **Fluent in English (Bengali/Hindi is a bonus for internal coordination)**
* **Detail\-oriented, disciplined, and proactive**
* **Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment**

title: IT Project Coordinator(West Bengal Candidates apply only)
description:
**IT Project Coordinator(West Bengal Candidates apply only)**

**Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month  
**Experience:** 2–3 years  
**Qualification:** B.Tech preferred  
**Preferred Academic Background:** Mathematics / Physics / Engineering  
**Immediate Joiners:** Preferred

Job Overview

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **IT Project Coordinator** with **2–3 years of hands\-on experience in IT project coordination and project handling**. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating project activities, tracking timelines, communicating with technical teams and stakeholders, and ensuring projects are delivered smoothly and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and monitor **end\-to\-end IT project activities**.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, UI/UX teams and other technical departments.
* Track project **scope, timelines, milestones and deliverables**.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules and status reports.
* Coordinate daily/weekly project meetings and follow up on action items.
* Communicate project updates, issues and dependencies to management.
* Identify project risks, delays and dependencies and escalate them when required.
* Ensure tasks are assigned to the appropriate team members and followed up regularly.
* Coordinate with clients/stakeholders regarding project requirements and progress.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting minutes and project trackers.
* Follow up with technical teams to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Support requirement gathering and ensure proper communication between business and technical teams.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to management.
* Assist in resolving project\-related issues and coordination gaps.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and requirements.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of experience in **IT Project Coordination / Project Management / Project Handling**.
* Hands\-on experience coordinating **software/IT projects**.
* Good understanding of the **software development lifecycle (SDLC)**.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, MS Office and project tracking tools**.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up, documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical teams.
* Good problem\-solving and organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Educational Qualification:\-

* **B.Tech / B.E. preferred.**
* Candidates with an academic background in **Mathematics, Physics or Engineering** will be preferred.
